S.FORM: sua miana cuumaku ia, u-cani saruanai u-rucini nannakə.
S.PHON: sua miana ʦuumaku ia uʦani saruanai urutʂini nannakə
S.FORM: sua miana cuumaku ia, ucani saruanai urucini nannake.
S.PHON: sua miana ʦuumaku ia uʦani sa[r|ɾ]uanai u[r|ɾ]utʂini nannake
S.TRANSL: In the past, my father's siblings included one brother and two sisters.

S.FORM: mia-iisua sua cuumaku ia, ʔuuna ʔucaŋə.
S.PHON: miaiisua sua ʦuumaku ia ʔuuna ʔuʦaŋə
S.FORM: miaiisua sua cuumaku ia, 'uuna 'ucange.
S.PHON: miaiisua sua ʦuumaku ia ʔuuna ʔuʦaŋe
S.TRANSL: At that time my father had a wife.

S.FORM: ni-mu-kusa cakəranə t<um>uncu mia-iisua sua ciina=maku ia, ni-pivəra.
S.PHON: nimukusa ʦakəranə tumunʦu miaiisua sua tʂiinamaku ia nipivəra
S.FORM: nimukusa cakerane t<um>uncu miaiisua sua ciinamaku ia, nipivera.
S.PHON: nimukusa ʦake[r|ɾ]ane tumunʦu miaiisua sua tʂiinamaku ia nipive[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: He went to the stream to poison fish, my mother being pregnant at that time.

S.FORM: mia-iisua ia, ki-papa cuumaku t<um>uncu.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia kipapa ʦuumaku tumunʦu
S.FORM: miaiisua ia, kipapa cuumaku t<um>uncu.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia kipapa ʦuumaku tumunʦu
S.TRANSL: She followed my father going to poison fish at that time.

S.FORM: si nuu ʔuuna=ci vutukulu ia, tia=cu ala-ən=kiai.
S.PHON: ʂi nuu ʔuunatʂi vutukuɾu ia tiaʦu aɾaənkiai
S.FORM: si nuu 'uunaci vutukuru ia, tiacu araenkiai.
S.PHON: ʂi nuu ʔuunatʂi vutuku[r|ɾ]u ia tiaʦu a[r|ɾ]aenkiai
S.TRANSL: If there were fish, she would take them.

S.FORM: makasua=cu ki-papa cuumaku m-usu-calu na vaatu.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu kipapa ʦuumaku musuʦaɾu na vaatu
S.FORM: makasuacu kipapa cuumaku musucaru na vaatu.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu kipapa ʦuumaku musuʦa[r|ɾ]u na vaatu
S.TRANSL: In that way she followed my father and fell on a rock.

S.FORM: si ni-pivəra sua cina=maku mia-iisua.
S.PHON: ʂi nipivəra sua tʂinamaku miaiisua
S.FORM: si nipivera sua cinamaku miaiisua.
S.PHON: ʂi nipive[r|ɾ]a sua tʂinamaku miaiisua
S.TRANSL: Because my mother was pregnant at that time.

S.FORM: aranai ʔinia cuumaku um-ava=ci cina=maku mu-caanə tanasa.
S.PHON: aranai ʔinia ʦuumaku umavatʂi tʂinamaku muʦaanə tanasa
S.FORM: aranai 'inia cuumaku umavaci cinamaku mucaane tanasa.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]anai ʔinia ʦuumaku umavatʂi tʂinamaku muʦaane tanasa
S.TRANSL: My father carried my mother home on his back.

S.FORM: mia-iisua ia, ta-susa=kimi sua kin-vaal-a.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia tasusakimi sua kinvaaɾa
S.FORM: miaiisua ia, tasusakimi sua kinvaara.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia tasusakimi sua kinvaa[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: There were two brothers of us at that time.

S.FORM: ma-naasə aaka cəpəŋ-ini si ma-ʔula=pa=kimi mia-iisua
S.PHON: manaasə aaka ʦəpəŋini ʂi maʔuɾapakimi miaiisua
S.FORM: manaase aaka cepengini si ma'urapakimi miaiisua
S.PHON: manaase aaka ʦepeŋini ʂi maʔu[r|ɾ]apakimi miaiisua
S.TRANSL: He probably felt very bad because we were still very small.

S.FORM: makasua=cu sua cuumaku ia, ala-i=kan ʔinia nua-nuamani um-aka-aka.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu sua ʦuumaku ia aɾaikan ʔinia nuanuamani umakaaka
S.FORM: makasuacu sua cuumaku ia, araikan 'inia nuanuamani umakaaka.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu sua ʦuumaku ia a[r|ɾ]aikan ʔinia nuanuamani umakaaka
S.TRANSL: My father destroyed everything.

S.FORM: sua cuumaku ia, nuu tia=m-ia-pacai kimia.
S.PHON: sua ʦuumaku ia nuu tiamiapaʦai kimia
S.FORM: sua cuumaku ia, nuu tiamiapacai kimia.
S.PHON: sua ʦuumaku ia nuu tiamiapaʦai kimia
S.TRANSL: Then my father was going to kill us.

S.FORM: nakai ʔuuna ta-susa vai cuumaku nannakə, ŋanai-ni ia, kiini mata ʔuuva, ŋuai ʔisua sua mati-saaʔə kimia um-aŋuru.
S.PHON: nakai ʔuuna tasusa vai ʦuumaku nannakə ŋanaini ia kiini mata ʔuuva ŋuai ʔisua sua matisaaʔə kimia umaŋuru
S.FORM: nakai 'uuna tasusa vai cuumaku nannake, nganaini ia, kiini mata 'uuva, nguai 'isua sua matisaa'e kimia umanguru.
S.PHON: nakai ʔuuna tasusa vai ʦuumaku nannake ŋanaini ia kiini mata ʔuuva ŋuai ʔisua sua matisaaʔe kimia umaŋu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: Fortunately, my father had two sisters, named Kiini and 'Uuva; it is they who took us away and escaped.

S.FORM: mii tia=ci ma-səŋəcə sua cuumaku ia, makasua maamia=cu ara-aka.
S.PHON: mii tiatʂi masəŋəʦə sua ʦuumaku ia makasua maamiaʦu araaka
S.FORM: mii tiaci masengece sua cuumaku ia, makasua maamiacu araaka.
S.PHON: mii tiatʂi maseŋeʦe sua ʦuumaku ia makasua maamiaʦu a[r|ɾ]aaka
S.TRANSL: My father was going to commit suicide, and then he died.

S.FORM: sua vai cuumaku kimia ŋuai ʔisua ni-pa-pa-cəvərə kimia ʔapa-ta-lava mii tavalaʔə=ci=kia mu-ca-caanə tia=kirimi kaən-a.
S.PHON: sua vai ʦuumaku kimia ŋuai ʔisua nipapaʦəvərə kimia ʔapataɾava mii tavaɾaʔətʂikia muʦaʦaanə tiakirimi kaəna
S.FORM: sua vai cuumaku kimia nguai 'isua nipapacevere kimia 'apatarava mii tavara'ecikia mucacaane tiakirimi kaena.
S.PHON: sua vai ʦuumaku kimia ŋuai ʔisua nipapaʦeve[r|ɾ]e kimia ʔapata[r|ɾ]ava mii tava[r|ɾ]aʔetʂikia muʦaʦaane tiaki[r|ɾ]imi kaena
S.TRANSL: It was my father's sisters who supported us until I was able to walk and look for food.

S.FORM: makasua=cu tavalaʔə=ci=kia mu-ca-caanə, ara-u-kukunu sumukunu.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu tavaɾaʔətʂikia muʦaʦaanə araukukunu sumukunu
S.FORM: makasuacu tavara'ecikia mucacaane, araukukunu sumukunu.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu tava[r|ɾ]aʔetʂikia muʦaʦaane a[r|ɾ]aukukunu sumukunu
S.TRANSL: When I knew how to walk, I was together with the Bunun people.

S.FORM: m-ali-sunatə ara-tatia=cu.
S.PHON: maɾisunatə aratatiaʦu
S.FORM: marisunate aratatiacu.
S.PHON: ma[r|ɾ]isunate a[r|ɾ]atatiaʦu
S.TRANSL: I went to school when I grew older.

S.FORM: si nanala=kia ʔakia maamia tapaacapa.
S.PHON: ʂi nanaɾakia ʔakia maamia tapaaʦapa
S.FORM: si nanarakia 'akia maamia tapaacapa.
S.PHON: ʂi nana[r|ɾ]akia ʔakia maamia tapaaʦapa
S.TRANSL: Because I was an orphan, without anyone to support me.

S.FORM: si ʔakia ma-maraŋ, mu-a-caca=kia maamia cucua k<um>aən.
S.PHON: ʂi ʔakia mamaraŋ muaʦaʦakia maamia ʦuʦua kumaən
S.FORM: si 'akia mamarang, muacacakia maamia cucua k<um>aen.
S.PHON: ʂi ʔakia mama[r|ɾ]aŋ muaʦaʦakia maamia ʦuʦua kumaen
S.TRANSL: Because I had no parents, I could only walk around and eat with other people.

S.FORM: makasua c<in>uvər-a=maku aranai mi tiʔiŋ-ai=pa=kia mata-lava na ara-tatia=ci=kia.
S.PHON: makasua tʂinuvəramaku aranai mi tiʔiŋaipakia mataɾava na aratatiatʂikia
S.FORM: makasua c<in>uveramaku aranai mi ti'ingaipakia matarava na aratatiacikia.
S.PHON: makasua tʂinuve[r|ɾ]amaku a[r|ɾ]anai mi tiʔiŋaipakia mata[r|ɾ]ava na a[r|ɾ]atatiatʂikia
S.TRANSL: That is how I have been raised since I was a young child.

S.FORM: makasua=cu mari-sunatə ara-tatia.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu marisunatə aratatia
S.FORM: makasuacu marisunate aratatia.
S.PHON: makasuaʦu ma[r|ɾ]isunate a[r|ɾ]atatia
S.TRANSL: In that way I went to school when I grew older.

S.FORM: ʔakia sua nakəvə mata kaən-a ʔapa-ta-lava taniara sauni.
S.PHON: ʔakia sua nakəvə mata kaəna ʔapataɾava taniara sauni
S.FORM: 'akia sua nakeve mata kaena 'apatarava taniara sauni.
S.PHON: ʔakia sua nakeve mata kaena ʔapata[r|ɾ]ava tania[r|ɾ]a sauni
S.TRANSL: I went without clothes and food until today.
